title: Build an AI Startup with Zero Funding
full_monologue: Start with a clear problem and a bold idea. Focus on building a prototype with free tools and open-source frameworks. Leverage online communities for feedback and collaboration. Use your network to gain early adopters and build momentum. Stay lean, iterate fast, and keep your vision sharp. Now, what’s your AI startup idea?
